findings.location: Paragraph beginning “We decide someone is proud…”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mlinzi wa nyumba asiyejali” with “mama wa nyumbani asiyejali” to convey “negligent homemaker.”
Replace “Usijibu tabia yake kwa hasira” with “Usiitikie tabia yake” so the source instruction is not narrowed by adding “with anger.”

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “The Bible describes the brutality…”
findings.source_quote: “Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy? –Proverbs 27:4.”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise “hasira ni gharika” to convey that anger is outrageous or overwhelming, rather than saying that anger is a flood; retain the reference “Mithali 27:4.”
findings.translation_quote: “Ghadhabu ni kali, na hasira ni gharika; lakini ni nani awezaye kusimama mbele ya husuda? –Mithali 27:4.”

findings.location: Dialogue paragraph beginning “It was one point in a message”
findings.source_quote: “If you feel critical toward someone who is rejoicing”
findings.suggested_fix: Consider “Ikiwa unamwona mtu anayeshangilia kwa jicho la ukosoaji” to preserve the sense of feeling critical toward that person, rather than judging them.
